project.name: Project Graph
project.description: Graph used to persist project context, decisions, discoveries and work performed by agents.

nodes.title: Create project graph file
nodes.description: Create the project graph file that will contain the initial project graph structure.

The absence of the file was intentional. The agent is authorized to create the file because creating the graph is the purpose of the current task.

Create the missing project graph file after user validation.
Created the initial project graph file using graph version 1.0.

edges.description: The missing file was discovered while executing the task.

The user's clarification authorized the agent to create the file.
The agent performed an attempt to determine the correct action.
The uncertainty was resolved by the user's clarification and the resulting agent decision.

node_types.PROJECT: Root container for all project knowledge.
node_types.USER_DECISION: Decision or clarification explicitly provided by the user.
node_types.AGENT_DECISION: Decision made by an agent while executing work.
node_types.TASK: Unit of work that an agent can execute.
node_types.SUBTASK: Task that belongs to another task.
node_types.HYPOTHESIS: Possible explanation or assumption that has not been validated.
node_types.DISCOVERY: New relevant information discovered during execution.
node_types.ATTEMPT: An action or approach attempted to solve a task.
node_types.FAILURE: An attempt that did not achieve its intended result.
node_types.SOLUTION: An approach that successfully solves a problem or task.
node_types.REJECTED_APPROACH: An approach explicitly rejected or determined unsuitable.
node_types.QUESTION: Unresolved question requiring an answer.
node_types.CONFLICT: Contradiction between decisions, facts or requirements.
node_types.ARTIFACT: File, code, document or other project output.
node_types.COMPONENT: Logical or technical component of the project.
node_types.DEPENDENCY: External or internal dependency required by the project.

edge_types.USER_VALIDATE: User clarification validates or resolves an agent observation or decision.
edge_types.DISCOVERED_BY: Information was discovered while executing the source.
edge_types.CREATED_BY: Artifact or information was created by an agent.
edge_types.SOLVED_BY: Problem was resolved by the target.
edge_types.SUPERSEDES: New decision replaces an older decision.
edge_types.IMPLEMENTS: Source implements target decision or requirement.
edge_types.ASSIGNED_TO: Work is assigned to an agent.

agents.description: Agent responsible for executing the current task.
